scope: Proposition 2.2 (Energy of a filtered path body) of the manuscript “The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström theorem” (preprints/The-Euclidean-Steinitz-Bergstrom-theorem-September-24-2026/The-Euclidean-Steinitz-Bergstrom-theorem-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 097 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d8924ac01b6d4dc0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 5-6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are positive absolute constants A0, B0, H0 with the following property. Let d ≥ 1 and n ≥ 0 be integers and put m = d + n. For 1 ≤ t ≤ n, let Ct be an invertible real d × d matrix and let bt ∈ Rd satisfy CtCT t + btbT t = Id. Define linear maps Rt : Rm → Rd by R0x = (x1, . . . , xd), Rtx = CtRt−1x + btxd+t (1 ≤ t ≤ n). (4) 5 Then the bounded open convex centrally symmetric set D = { x ∈ Rm : |xj| < B0 (1 ≤ j ≤ m), ∥Rtx∥2 < A0 √ d (0 ≤ t ≤ n) } (5) satisfies λQ(D) ≤ H0 tr Q for every positive definite diagonal Q.
